headline: Oil Prices Decline as Diplomatic Efforts Ease Middle East Escalation Fears
summary: Crude oil futures fell as diplomatic mediation involving Iran reduced immediate supply disruption concerns, despite lingering tension from Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.
why: Crude oil prices benchmark global energy costs, strongly influencing international inflation expectations and central bank interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: Brent Crude Oil
impacts.why: Diplomatic mediation in the Middle East reduced the geopolitical risk premium priced into crude oil futures.

why_moved: Middle East diplomatic progress dampened trader concerns over immediate oil supply disruptions, driving crude futures lower.
